clock.algorithm: elapsed=(sample-prev)&FFFF; while elapsed>divider: elapsed-=divider; n++; if n: prev=sample; fine+=n
clock.coarse_rule: 7050 increments coarse once when (fine-last_coarse_fine)&FFFF >=1001; stores fine at102:103.
clock.AB22_rule: B8:B9 = (fine & 0x7FFF) or 1; not a raw counter getter.
clock.physical_unit: Unconfirmed; use native counts. F22 masks and software divisors alone do not prove clock frequency.

state_85.gate_zero_rationale: Allow native wake service first if this request was set after the main-loop check.

state_28.exit_effect: If nonzero: clear0, prepare delay, queue RSUU0\r and RSUW1\r.
state_28.meaning_proven: Radio command inhibition / radio mode lifecycle flag.
state_28.meaning_inferred: Sleep/suspend mode is suggested by wake-latch handling; hardware power state not established.

irq_scratch_overlap.conclusion: For the original initialized object invariants, IRQ writes neither B0..FD nor FF nor2C0..2FF. RAM0FE must remain live and must not be restored from an earlier snapshot.

proposed_nonblocking_gate.status: Conservative admission conditions supported by original state/IRQ paths; not a proof of physical radio idle.
proposed_nonblocking_gate.operation: Check immediately before nonblocking original enqueue; otherwise retain the pending AIR2 update for a later UI service.
do_not: Do not clear native flags or camera state.
Do not busy-wait for camera idle or queue capacity.
Do not mask camera IRQs for a whole packet or bypass the original UART/queue.
Do not label RAM28 as confirmed hardware busy.
proposed_nonblocking_gate.race_limit: An IRQ may arrive after the last check. IRQ does not produce TX queue bytes, so frame insertion remains structurally valid; a newly pending camera transmission may still follow the AIR2 frame. Physical HSS timing needs validation.

limits: No MCU-specific SFR names or clock frequency are inferred from addresses.
CFG proof relies on pinned original code and the local classic-PIC18 decoder.
Counter replays use explicitly fixed peripheral values, not a simulated oscillator.
No assertion that radio air-time, UART completion or all HSS latency is unchanged.

irq_table_nvm_audit.banked_screening: Any matching low byte in any bank is retained; no default-BSR assumption.
irq_table_nvm_audit.indirect_store_limit: Nine indirect writes resolve to native camera/RX/timer RAM under initialized-object invariants, not these SFRs.
irq_table_nvm_audit.conclusion: The original IRQ neither saves nor modifies TBLPTR/TABLAT and does not execute table or NVM-control instructions.
backend_requirement: There is no native-IRQ TBL register collision requiring a larger critical section around all TBL reads/writes.
Still preserve foreground TBLPTR/TABLAT through the outer hook context.
Preserve the native unlock/start sequence while saving and restoring the original relevant control bits.
Do not call a native helper that unconditionally enables bits and only repair them after RETURN; that creates an incorrect-enable window.
Restore specific saved control bits, not complete interrupt-control/flag bytes whose pending flags may have changed.
No MCU register names or hardware Flash-stall duration are inferred here; verify those separately before release.
